summary: Masi-Manimba territory part 1 (Kwilu) covers the Masi-Manimba and Yasa-Bonga secteurs, including Masi-Manimba town on the RN1 and the large settlement of Kimbinga. No armed group is reported to control any locality; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, western Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west and holdouts were still raiding parts of the region in 2026, so the western fringe is flagged as exposed to raids. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as main permanent force. Live web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the territorial seat and low elsewhere.

zones.description: Masi-Manimba town, territorial seat on the RN1 (Masi Manimba health zone)
zones.evidence: Territorial seat with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and courts on the Kinshasa-Kikwit RN1; no armed group is reported to hold the town. The December 2023 elections here were annulled over fraud and violence, but that unrest did not displace state authority. The Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, western Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west. Live web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on prior knowledge and regional reports cited by neighbouring assessments.

zones.description: Western Masi-Manimba secteur toward the Kwango/Kenge and Bagata borders (Kimbinga, Kiwawa Pont, Kiwawa Kapadi, Munzabala, Kifunga Centre and Moanza health zone villages, lon < 17.8)
zones.evidence: The Mobondo militia spread from Kwamouth into Bagata, Kenge and other areas along the Kwango in 2023-2025 and holdouts were still raiding in mid-2026 despite an August 2026 peace process; this western fringe is the part of the unit nearest that theatre, so occasional incursions cannot be excluded. No locality here is known to be under lasting Mobondo rule, so ordinary state authority (PNC posts, customary chiefs) is assumed. Live web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on prior knowledge and regional reports cited by neighbouring assessments.

zones.description: Central, eastern and southern Masi-Manimba secteur villages along the RN1 and toward Mosango/Moanza (Kitsamanga, Kiko, Lumbi Daniel, Mosenge, Kimbiki etc.)
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group control located for these villages; state authority via PNC posts, territorial administration and customary chiefs is assumed. Neighbouring Bulungu territory to the east is likewise assessed as calm. Live web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on prior knowledge and regional reports cited by neighbouring assessments.

zones.description: Yasa-Bonga secteur (northern Masi-Manimba territory: Mafwa, Pupu, Mungoto, Yelenge, Dunda Bac, Saka Centre, Kwaya Centre etc., Yasa Bonga and Vanga health zones)
zones.evidence: No armed-group activity is reported in the Yasa-Bonga secteur, which lies between Bagata (Mobondo-affected only in its far western fringe) and Bulungu/Vanga; ordinary state authority with PNC posts and customary chiefs is assumed. Live web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on prior knowledge and regional reports cited by neighbouring assessments.
